content.short: Tonkeeper is the leading non-custodial wallet for the TON ecosystem, featuring the fee-abstracting Battery.
content.description:
Tonkeeper is the premier self-custodial digital asset manager built natively for The Open Network (TON), designed to provide a seamless and highly secure gateway to the decentralized web. The wallet supports a wide range of assets—including Toncoin, Jettons, and NFTs—within a transparent and intuitive interface. A standout innovation is "Tonkeeper Battery," a fee-abstraction mechanism that allows users to pay transaction costs using any supported asset, eliminating the need to hold native TON tokens for every interaction.

Deeply integrated with the TON ecosystem, Tonkeeper features a built-in dApp browser and secure staking tools, enabling participants to manage their decentralized portfolios with professional-grade precision. By leveraging the high speed and scalability of the TON network, the wallet delivers near-instant transaction finality and robust cryptographic security. As the primary portal for millions of TON users, Tonkeeper is dedicated to providing the essential infrastructure needed for mass adoption, empowering participants to maintain total sovereignty over their digital identity and capital.
